thread:
sam: Heads-up: scheduling runtime v3.2.0 -> v3.3.0 soft-unpin next change window (EU morning). We still have quant-v4 models on pinlist. Need final decision: do we soft-unpin runtime for longseq quant workloads? cc @maria @leo

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Change window scheduled: Apr 5 08:00 UTC -> runtime-unpin-canary, runbook https://go/redwood/runbooks/runtime-unpin. Do not merge until ack.

maria: I'm seeing ~2% increased tail latency on quant-v4b in canary. Not sure it's from runtime change or host kernel. Logs: `ooms: 0, mem_grows: 0.5%`

leo: @maria can you paste the canary job id? We should compare kv-cache hit rates. If kv cache drops, we should soft-pin the model group and run a patched rollout.

maria: canary job id: canary-2026-04-04-21
kv_hit: 0.92 -> 0.86 post-build. Not huge but consistent. Repro snippet:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"quant-v4b","input":"x..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

anya: Telemetry shows spike in kv-cache misses correlated with runtime 3.3's kernel selection. Suggest soft-pin quant-v4b until we land cache-fix. +1 for precaution.

infra-bot: infra-bot: Auto-detected config drift: runtime 3.3 picks kernel kernel_avx512_v2 for longseq on xen-rt-7, which increases cache allocations. Flagging for ops.

sam: We should delay global unpin. Proposal: soft-unpin only on hosts with kernel_avx512_v2 disabled, and patch runtime to fallback kernel selection. Rollback plan: reapply pinlist by model group and set traffic split to 0% within 10m via deploy tool.

maria: LGTM. Pinlist diff I would push:
```
- quant-v4b: runtime: -> allow_unpin: true
+ quant-v4b: runtime: allow_unpin: false  # keep pinned until cache-fix
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Noted. Change window paused. Action: hold canary -> scheduled-unpin-paused. Link to emergency rollback playbook: https://go/redwood/playbooks/unpin-rollback

sam: Thanks. @leo can you own the kernel fallback patch? I'll update release notes and notify customers in the cohort. :thumbsup:

leo: On it. Expect PR by EOD, will add unit test and a tracer to ensure kernel choice logged.

maria: I'll keep monitoring canary. If kv_hit < 0.88 for 15m, we escalate.
